newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes stronger confirming gains.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes stronger confirming gains.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed stronger on Wednesday as the market consolidated after recent gains that have broken a four week range.
April closed $3.00 a tonne stronger at $175.00 having briefly toyed with $176.75, which attracted some selling pressure.
May Brent crude trading 15 cents stronger at $20.40 by 1745 GMT.
"Gas oil is looking comfortable at these higher numbers and the market is waiting for these levels to be confirmed," said one trader.
Outright volume was viewed as thin.
"We have seen a fair bit of cross-over broker trading," said one dealer.
Support for April was seen at $174, today's low with selling interest likely to kick in around $176.25.
